name: The Fuse Relit
reviewNotes:
Added automatically from Kitty Mulligan's Irish Pub (Bay Shore) - events. Check the name and add a website or social page.

Directory research 2026-10-04: The band has no site of its own; its page sits on the IDOLized (Billy Idol tribute) site, which the same six musicians share, so the website/booking/phone are shared with IDOLized. Phone is published there for bookings. No Facebook/Instagram/YouTube links were found on that site or confirmed in search. Do not confuse with other bands called 'The Fuse' (UK band, others on Bandsintown/Songkick). Member names appear on the Eleanor's listing but are not recorded. Other images on the page are show flyers, so only one photo was taken.
description: A Long Island rock cover band that brings back the local band The Fuse with two of its original members. The six-piece plays high-energy, danceable hits from the '80s and '90s; the same musicians also perform as IDOLized, a Billy Idol tribute.

logo.alt: The Fuse Relit logo: the words The Fuse in bold white letters with Relit in script, inside a black circle with a white ring

photos.alt: The six members of The Fuse Relit posing on a club stage in front of their round logo banner

evidence.note: Kitty Mulligan's (Bay Shore) lists 'Live Music: The Fuse Relit!' for a Halloween party on Sat Oct 31, 7:30-10:30 PM, matching our listing.

The IDOLized band site has a page for The Fuse: the same musicians play non-stop '80s and '90s dance hits; it quotes a review naming The Fuse Relit and shows its logo and a show flyer listing Kitty Mulligan's dates.
Contact page: 'For bookings & all other inquiries - Call/Text' a 631 number, plus a message form.
Eleanor's Lounge (Bohemia) bills The Fuse Relit as 'Long Island Legends - The New Fuse', high-energy danceable rock, with original members plus four new players.

factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: kittymulligans.com, idolized.rocks, eleanorslounge.com.
